QuestInfo.name: The Prince's Request 2
QuestInfo.0: You got #b#p1092003##k's gifts back, but now his face is glowing bright red. What? Is he embarrassed about something?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092003##k is too shy to deliver the gifts himself. Give them to #b#p1090000##k on his behalf.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered gifts to #b#p1090000##k. Why did #b#p1092003##k even bother with gifts if he was so shy?

0.0: I still have one problem, though. I'm, well, a little nervous presenting these gifts to #b#p1090000##k. I'm just not that good with...you know. People stuff. Could you maybe...?
0.1: Please, #h0#! This is the last favor I'll ask for. Please, #h0#?\r\n

yes.0: Please deliver this gift to #b#p1090000##k. Of course, you must tell her that it's from me.

no.0: Should I just go back, then?

1.0: Ahoy there! Heard you've become quite the swashbuckler lately! Good for you. What brings you aboard?

yes.0: Heh, I see. Prince #b#p1092003##k is here...he's just too shy to meet with me. Don't worry, I don't mind. I get that a lot, anyway. Thanks for helping the prince out.

npc.0: Please deliver my gift to Kyrin.

item.0: Oh, if you have no business, I need to prepare. Prince Sharyl should be here soon.
